test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

No one can __exterminate__ poverty from this world.
solution:
The correct answer is '**E****radicate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 

__
 
• '**Exterminate**' in this context refers to the complete destruction or elimination of something.

 
 
• **Example**: The goal is to exterminate the invasive species in the region.
 
 
 
• '**Eradicate**' is a synonym for 'exterminate', also meaning to destroy or eliminate completely.
 
 
• **Example**: Efforts are being made to eradicate illiteracy.
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 

 
• '**Plant**' generally refers to placing or fixing something firmly.
 
• '**Endure**' refers to suffering something patiently.
 
• '**Secure**' often refers to fixing or protecting something.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Eradicate'.
